scope: Theorem 3.7 (Uniform local control) of the manuscript “Infinitely many closed geodesic images on every Riemannian sphere” (preprints/Infinitely-many-closed-geodesic-images-on-every-Riemannian-sphere-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 345 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 123ee5276415debb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume there are finitely many prime images. There are constants A, B < ∞ such that every sufficiently tight crossing of a positive critical level has the following properties. (i) It decomposes into unoriented labels (i, m) at that level. Let Pi,m be the ordinary pair for one orientation. Then X j dim Hj (Pi,m; F2) ≤ B, Hj (Pi,m; F2) = 0 if |j − Ii,m| > A. (ii) Its reflection block is induced from Pi,m; its K-block is induced from the ⟨τ⟩-action on that pair. For odd m the fixed label is empty. For even m, the ordinary fixed pair has total rank at most B and support |j − Ii,m/2| ≤ A. (iii) Full-to-fixed restriction respects the labels. These identifications are compatible with ambient maps and connecting homomorphisms. (iv) Cup product by e = ev∗ 0[Sn]∗ ∈ Hn R(Λ; F2) vanishes on the reflection crossing, including each individual label. The constants depend on the metric and the finite prime list, and include all degenerate iterates and all zero-mean-index primes.
